summary.text: Mike Dovilla is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 17 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Ohio House from 2011 to 2016 and has served in the U.S. Navy Reserve since 2002.

paragraphs.text: Mike Dovilla was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and graduated from Berea High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science and economics from Baldwin-Wallace College, an M.P.A. from American University, and a graduate degree from the U.S. Naval War College in 2023.
Ballotpedia says he has served in the U.S. Navy Reserve since 2002.

Dovilla's professional experience includes serving as an appointee at the U.S. Office of Personnel Management, senior advisor to former U.S. Senator George Voinovich, Presidential Management Fellow at the U.S. Department of State, adjunct professor at Baldwin Wallace University, and owner of the consulting firm The Dovilla Group.
He represented Ohio House District 7 from 2011 to 2016 and returned to the House for District 17 on January 1, 2025.
Ballotpedia lists his current committees as Finance (vice chair), Workforce and Higher Education, and Veterans and Military Development.
